# A function a test hands its instance to is inlined as the call would run
# it, on every target: its locals and loop variables are its own, however
# often it is inlined and whatever the test's locals are named; an argument
# is evaluated before the body runs; a parameter the body writes is a copy of
# its argument; an omitted argument is its default; and a return inside a
# lambda the body builds is the lambda's.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #hit(text="{label}{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    vbox {
        badge #bd(label="b")
        button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
    }
}

func hitBadge(b badge, times int) {
    var i = 0
    for i < times {
        b.hit.click()
        i = i + 1
    }
}

func clickAndCheck(t Test, c main, before int) {
    c.k.click()
    t.assert(before == 0)
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
}

func clickN(c main, n int = 2) {
    for n > 0 {
        c.k.click()
        n = n - 1
    }
}

func clickEach(c main, xs list[int]) {
    var doubled = xs.map(func(x int) int {
        return x * 2
    })
    for var d = doubled {
        c.k.click()
    }
}

func testLambdaReturn(t Test, c main) {
    clickEach(c, [1, 2])
    t.assert(c.hits == 2)
}

func testLocals(t Test, c main) {
    var i = 2
    hitBadge(c.bd, i)
    t.assert(c.bd.hits == 2)
    hitBadge(c.bd, 1)
    t.assert(c.bd.hits == 3)
    t.assert(i == 2)
}

func testArgsBeforeBody(t Test, c main) {
    clickAndCheck(t, c, c.hits)
}

func testParamWrite(t Test, c main) {
    var m = 2
    clickN(c, m)
    t.assert(c.hits == 2)
    t.assert(m == 2)
    clickN(c, 1)
    t.assert(c.hits == 3)
}

func testDefault(t Test, c main) {
    clickN(c)
    t.assert(c.hits == 2)
    clickN(n=3, c=c)
    t.assert(c.hits == 5)
}

window {
    main
}
